build_biknn_radius_graph: build a BiKNN radius graph from an AtomicData object with configurable soft or hard KNN ranking
build_batched_radius_graph: build a batched BiKNN radius graph for multiple atomic systems with padding and envelope filtering
build_radius_graph_single: build a BiKNN radius graph for a single atomic system with periodic boundary conditions
build_radius_graph_chunked: build a memory-efficient chunked BiKNN radius graph processing source atoms in configurable chunk sizes
compute_segment_argsort_vectorized: compute the argsort of values within each segment using a vectorized cumsum-based approach
